subject: Playbacks & proofchain for VM closure - SOC 2 evidence request
messages:
From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@fintrust.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: SOC2 Audit Team <soc2@audits.example.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Dec 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: VM playback + immutable proofchain for SOC 2

Hi Karthik,

As part of our SOC 2 audit next week, the auditors have asked for an end-to-end playback demonstrating the lifecycle of CVE remediation for a recent critical finding (CVE-2027-1456). Specifically they want:
- scan snapshots showing detection timestamps
- the patch manifest (who/what/when)
- evidence that a rollback would preserve a verifiable chain (hashes/signatures)
- any SIEM/ingestion links that show the timeline

Can Redwood provide a single evidence packet (attachments or Drive folder) and a short signed attestation stating the SLA we applied and the closure dates?

We need this by EOD Thursday (2027-12-16) to make the audit window. Happy to take a brief call if useful.

Thanks,
Maria Lopez
Sr. Security Manager, FinTrust

--
FinTrust - Security Ops
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Dec 2027 09:38:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: VM playback + immutable proofchain for SOC 2

Laura / Ben,

Forwarding FinTrust's ask. Deadline is EOD Thu 12/16. This is time-sensitive — auditors need a single, verifiable packet. Please assemble:
- scan snapshots (raw scanner output + trimmed CSV) for detection -> first-open times
- patch manifest with deploy job IDs and operator usernames
- a small playback artifact: ordered messages that map detection -> ticket -> patch -> verification
- rollback_proofchain: we should include SHA256 hashes of the pre/post images, signed with our KMS key (or an HMAC manifest if we can sign quickly)
- SIEM links and any observability traces that show successful validation after patch

Ben: can you export the scanner snapshots and reconciliation log? Give me a confidence level (high/medium/low).
Laura: please draft an attestation PDF I can sign that states SLA applied (48-hour critical), actual closure timestamps, and a short note about exception handling.
Kimberly: loop in infra if we need signed images from the build pipeline (I think we do).

I'll coordinate a final review before we send to Maria and cc the SOC2 team. If anyone expects blockers, flag immediately.

Thanks — Karthik
VP, Customer Security & Trust
Redwood Inference

Maria / Audit team — attaching the evidence packet we discussed and a short signed attestation. Summary below.

Summary of artifacts included (attachments + Drive links):
- scan_snapshot_20271214.zip: raw scanner export + reconciled CSV (detection timestamps).
- patch_manifest_20271214.csv: deploy job IDs, operator usernames, and changelog entries.
- cve_ticket_playback_20271214.json: ordered mapping (scanner -> Jira RDW-1784 -> deploy #3421 -> verify #3422).
- rollback_proofchain_SHA256.txt: SHA256 pre/post image hashes. These hashes were generated by the build pipeline and recorded in our immutable artifact store.
- signed_attestation_karthik_iyer.pdf: brief attestation (I signed) that states Redwood applied a 48-hour SLA for critical CVEs, closure occurred on 2027-12-14T22:31:00Z, and that rollback evidence exists and is verifiable.

External links: Drive folder with granular logs and SIEM reference (https://drive.redwood.example.com/drive/folders/VM-EVIDENCE-FINTRUST-20271214). SIEM event link: https://siem.partner.example.com/links/evt-7b3f2.

If you need HSM-signed artifacts instead of the KMS signature, let us know and we will run an additional signing cycle (takes ~2 business days).

Ben / Laura / Kimberly: thanks for the fast turnaround.

Karthik Iyer
VP, Customer Security & Trust
Redwood Inference
